title: Cambodia and Vietnam in Ten Days
alt: Floating village houses on stilts on Tonle Sap lake
transport: Flights between the cities, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Hanoi city tour
activities.description: The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the lanes of the old quarter with a guide.

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda
activities.description: A cycle ride through the rice fields to Bich Dong, a three tier pagoda built into the rock face.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter with the city on arrival, then a full day south in Ninh Binh.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Back in Hanoi
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: The Surprise Cave on the way off the water, then a night back in the city.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon, Cu Chi and the Mekong
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Saigon city tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

activities.name: Mekong Delta day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: The flight south for three nights, with the city, the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta.

stops.name: Siem Reap
stops.subtitle: Angkor and the lake
stops.hotel_label: HARI Residence and Spa Siem Reap
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel with a pool, a short ride from the old market

activities.name: Tonle Sap lake boat ride
activities.match: Boat Ride Tour of Tonle Sap Lake
activities.description: A boat out onto the great lake, through a floating village of houses, schools and shops built on stilts and pontoons.

activities.name: Angkor Wat day tour
activities.description: Angkor Wat itself, the Bayon faces at Angkor Thom and the root covered ruins of Ta Prohm, with a guide for the full day.

program.name: Siem Reap
program.description: On to Cambodia for the last two nights and a full day among the Angkor temples.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: The standard two country run: north Vietnam, the south, then Angkor. Four flights, no long drives.
expert.tip: Tonle Sap is best from September to November when the lake is high and the village is properly afloat.

summary: Ten days across both countries: two nights in Hanoi with a guided city tour and a Ninh Binh day, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, three nights in Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta, then two in Siem Reap with the floating villages of Tonle Sap and a full day at Angkor.
included: Included: 9 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at the Hanoi and Siem Reap hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; all flights between the cities; private transfers throughout; a guided tour of Hanoi; a Ninh Binh day tour; a cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a Saigon city tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Mekong Delta day tour; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam and Cambodia visa fees; lunches other than where stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
